title: Ramp prompt panel
description: An edge-to-edge panel with 12px corners over a misty grey backdrop: a centred headline and grey subline, a wide white prompt box whose border has a light running around it, an example request typing itself in, a small arrow send button, and a fine italic disclaimer at the foot.
notes: backdrop is a media slot; empty, it shows layered grey radial gradients (darker toward the foot so the disclaimer reads)
the border light is CSS (@property angle); the typing needs JavaScript and shows the first example in static HTML
name: ramp-recommend

props.name: title
props.description: the headline's first line, in ink

props.name: titleLine2
props.description: a second headline line, in ink too (optional)

props.name: prompts
props.description: example requests that type themselves into the box, one after another

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the send button

props.name: disclaimer
props.description: the fine print at the foot (may hold a link)

props.name: backdrop
props.description: the backdrop photo; empty shows a misty gradient
